svg.title: Alerts List and Timeline
svg.desc: Pulsus Dash alerts in split view: the List view (Alt+6) grouped by incident with Firing, Pending, Acknowledged, Silenced, NoData, Error and flapping states each shown by colour and glyph, and the Timeline view (Alt+7) with per-incident swimlanes of alert state bars, deploy and config markers, acks and notifications.

text.tspan: ⊘ stale 6 min, never shown as healthy

g.text: one swimlane per incident, expandable to its alerts · drag the Time Ribbon left for history
Alt+6 List and Alt+7 Timeline share one alert
set; \ splits them and the selection syncs.
Grouped by incident: one row per problem,
⊕ origin / ⇢ victim role on every alert.
Each state = colour + glyph, and in the
timeline a bar pattern: never colour alone.
⇅ flapping: > 4 flips in 10 min. Feeds the
◆ deploys and ⚙ config changes share the
axis with state bars, acks ✓ and sends ✉.
